# Third-party app artwork

Discord symbol: Bootstrap Icons v1.11.3, icons/discord.svg.
Source: https://github.com/twbs/icons/blob/v1.11.3/icons/discord.svg
License: see LICENSE.bootstrap-icons.txt in this directory.
The SVG shape and viewBox are unchanged; its fill is set to Discord Blurple (#5865F2).
Discord marks remain the property of Discord Inc. See https://discord.com/branding.
This independent UBos launcher is not published, sponsored, or endorsed by Discord.

Codex and Claude Code continue loading product artwork from the respective vendor-published Visual Studio Marketplace listings recorded in icons.js. These remote images need network access; they are not bundled by this patch.

This patch changes icon rendering only. It does not launch Discord, embed the desktop, or implement app-readiness loading states.
